name: BlackGatomon
xros_req: [Digivolve] Lv.3 w/[Three Musketeers] in text or w/[TS] trait: Cost 2
main_effect:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] If you have 1 or fewer Tamers, you may play 1 Tamer card with [Three Musketeers] in its text from your hand without paying the cost.
[All Turns] While you have a Tamer with [Three Musketeers] in its text, this Digimon may digivolve into a [Three Musketeers] trait Digimon card for a digivolution cost of 4, ignoring digivolution requirements.
source_effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By placing 1 [Three Musketeers] trait card from your hand or trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
